citation: Yonghan Jung, Min Woo Park, Sanghack Lee (2024). Complete Graphical Criterion for Sequential Covariate Adjustment in Causal Inference. NeurIPS 37.
status: Repository correction reviewed 2026-09-19; not a publisher-issued erratum. Counterexamples below were constructed for the correction, not printed as paper examples.

cases.name: future_intervention_chain
cases.adjudication: The supplied functional is sum_z p(z)p(y|x1,x2,z)=p(y|x2), the joint-intervention distribution in every positive compatible model.

cases.name: stale_history_pruning
cases.adjudication: Pruning C from the first canonical block requires recomputing the next history; otherwise X2<-C->Y becomes open. This defect is independent of the forbidden-set correction.
